snippet.title: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade, The Best Twin Stick Shooter Gameplay Trailer 👾🔥
snippet.description:
Manga heart. Synthwave soul. Arcade fury.
Come for 5mins, stay for hours of fun!

Neon Breaker is a challenging fast horizontal twin-stick shmup 3d retro shooter in the legacy of the great action arcade classics. 

Shoot, evade, and hunt down enemy ships to great synthwave music! 

Push your limits playing through endless waves and unlock new high scores.

Couch/Online Coop, Combos, Leaderboards, Roguelike mode, Replay and Mod support!

Get now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5054650/Neon_Breaker_Endless_Arcade/
